title: Gardener: Promote to first-class hub advisor — add advisor_id metadata and advisor.json identity file
perceive: Read hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/scan_state.json to see its current fields. Then read hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/compass/scan_state.json (the canonical advisor schema example) — it has advisor_id, advisor_name, version, mission_statement at the top level. Gardener's scan_state.json is missing these identity fields. The goal is to add them without touching any Python code.
execute: Step 1: Read hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/scan_state.json to capture its full current content. Step 2: Add these fields at the top of the JSON object (prepend before any existing fields): advisor_id='gardener', advisor_name='Gardener — Fleet Health Monitor', version='1.0.0', mission_statement='Keep all spokes green — nightly fleet health scans, remediation, and skill sync across all registered wheels'. Preserve ALL existing fields unchanged. Write the updated scan_state.json. Step 3: Create hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/advisor.json as a stable identity file (this is the unchanging identity record; scan_state is runtime state): {"id": "gardener", "name": "Gardener — Fleet Health Monitor", "role": "Expert", "version": "1.0.0", "mission": "Keep all spokes green — nightly fleet health scans, remediation, and skill sync across all registered wheels", "output_files": ["scan_state.json", "reports/{date}.json", "passes.jsonl", "vectors.jsonl"], "runs_in": "nightly via hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/scripts/wheel-tender.sh post-tend pipeline", "position_in_council": "member"}. Step 4: Move this lug from open/ to completed/ with status='completed' and completed_at set to now. Step 5: Append a turn entry to WAI-Spoke/sessions/session-20260331-1403/track.jsonl.
verify: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/scan_state.json')); assert d.get('advisor_id')=='gardener', 'advisor_id missing from gardener scan_state'" exits 0. python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/advisor.json'))" exits 0. No Python scripts were modified.
acceptance_criteria: scan_state.json has advisor_id='gardener', advisor_name, version, mission_statement at top level
advisor.json exists at hub/WAI-Hub/advisors/gardener/advisor.json and is valid JSON

python3 hub/tools/verify_health.py still runs without error after changes
